level_id_bank.verdict: Positional: MOIL blew off to a ~595 ATH in mid-2024 (12M/1M ladder-A 4.115) and has spent two years unwinding that parabola — now 280.05, ~53% off the high, below the FULL EMA/SMA stack on D/W/M (overhead 291-320) with monthly + weekly MACD negative = confirmed corrective downtrend. Price is resting on the 262-280 purple support box whose spine is the 274.30 DOUBLE-fib (ladder-A 1.115 + ladder-B 3.115) over the 262 (ladder-A 1.0) anchor — THE decision zone. Bias = this is a support TEST, not yet a reclaim: a buy-the-zone candidate ONLY on a hold + reclaim (daily close back above the 291-306 fib+MA cluster), with deeper value at 245 (2.618-B / Mar-26 spike low) and the 186-216 structural base on a full flush. Thesis-invalidation = decisive daily/weekly close below 262 -> opens 245 then 216. Resumption needs reclaim 306 -> 328 -> the 356-381 orange supply box that caps the structure. Position is CLOSED (book) — this is a level-bank/watch read, not a live position.
